numbering.convention: Hafs, Kufan count, as in the source: ayah numbers are Tanzil's own. In Al-Fatiha the basmala is ayah 1 (7 ayahs).

ayahs.text: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ
مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ

crossCheck.source: Quran Foundation Content API v4, text_uthmani (KFGQPC-based)
crossCheck.policy: Comparison result only; the other text is not stored (QF caching terms).

automatedChecks: 6236 ayahs, contiguous, per-surah counts equal metadata (114 suras)
no control characters, BOM or CR in ayah text
letter skeleton equals independent cross-check source
